title: Matte Black Bottle on Marble
tests: Produces a finished product image from text while honoring the stated material, setting and lighting.

judge.summary: A polished product photo shows a fully visible matte black water bottle on subtly veined marble with soft lighting and no evident defects.

must_haves.item: A water bottle is the main subject and is fully visible.
must_haves.why: The bottle dominates the composition and is visible from its cap to its base.

must_haves.item: The bottle has a matte black finish rather than a glossy or metallic finish.
must_haves.why: The black surface has a fine matte texture and restrained highlights rather than mirrorlike reflections.

must_haves.item: The bottle stands on a visibly veined marble surface.
must_haves.why: Subtle gray veins are visible across the pale marble beneath the bottle.

must_haves.item: Lighting is soft, with gentle shadows rather than harsh glare.
must_haves.why: Soft directional light produces smooth tonal transitions and a muted cast shadow without harsh glare.
